ASSUMPTIONS (model, not data)
  - Isolated target nucleus at rest (data are 0 K; no thermal motion, no chemical binding).
  - Probabilities are conditional on an interaction having occurred; they say nothing about interaction rates, mean free paths, materials or geometry.

$ python -m neutronsim sample U-235 --energy 1 --unit MeV -n 20000 --seed 42
